content: python-jose effectively unmaintained (last release 3.3.0) with open CVEs CVE-2024-33663 (algorithm confusion with OpenSSH ECDSA keys) and CVE-2024-33664; 2026 guidance and current FastAPI official tutorial use PyJWT (2.15.0, 2026-09-23) instead; migration is from jose import jwt to import jwt with explicit algorithms list.
